chapters.label: Discover
chapters.head: Everything about the mattress, topic by topic.

blocks.t: **Baby Cot Size** is made for cots and cot beds. **Junior Size** is made for junior and single beds. Each size is made to order, in the height you choose.
The right mattress is the one that matches the **inside** of your frame: it should fit snugly, with no gaps at the sides or ends.
Cot and bed sizes differ between manufacturers. Measure the inside of the frame, length and width, and check the maximum mattress height your cot or bed allows.

panels.label: Honest Promise
panels.title: What we say, and what we do not

blocks.t: One piece of 100% natural Dunlop latex with ventilation channels, inside a quilted 100% cotton cover with a zip along the side. Medium firmness. Made to order in the size and height you select.
We do not say this mattress suits every cot, and we make no medical claims. Always follow current guidance from the NHS and The Lullaby Trust, together with the instructions supplied with your cot.

chapters.label: Size
chapters.head: Two groups, eight sizes, every measurement in centimetres and inches.

blocks.t: Cot and bed sizes differ between manufacturers. The right mattress is the one that matches the inside of your frame.

t: **Measure inside.** Length and width of the cot or bed frame, not the outside.
**Match the size.** It should fit snugly, with no gaps at the sides or ends.
**Check your cot.** Follow its instructions on mattress size and maximum height.

chapters.label: Height
chapters.head: The lower or the higher core: your cot or bed decides.

blocks.t: Start with your cot or bed. Many cots state a **maximum mattress height**: choose a height within it.
Both heights share the same length and width, so the choice of size and the choice of height are independent.
A zip runs along the side, so the cover opens and the one-piece latex core inside can be seen and checked.
Follow the care instructions supplied with your mattress.

chapters.label: Latex Core
chapters.head: One piece of natural Dunlop latex.

blocks.t: The core is made with **Dunlop Technology** as a single block of 100% natural latex, with rows of ventilation channels formed in it during moulding.

chapters.label: Firmness
chapters.head: One firmness for the whole range.

blocks.t: The Baby & Junior range is made in a single firmness, **Medium**, in every size and height.
Our adult, weight-based firmness recommendations do not apply to babies and children and are not used for this range.

chapters.label: Care & Fit
chapters.head: Before it goes in the cot.

panels.label: Before Use
panels.title: Before it goes in the cot

t: **Fit.** Use it only in a cot or bed whose inner dimensions match the size you ordered, within the maximum height given by the cot manufacturer.
**Unpacking.** Remove all packaging, including any plastic wrapping, before use, and keep it away from children.
**Bedding.** Use a fitted sheet made for the exact mattress size. Keep the sleeping surface flat and clear.
**Cover.** Follow the care instructions supplied with your mattress.

blocks.t: If anyone in your household has a latex allergy, please seek medical advice before purchase.
Always follow current guidance from the NHS and The Lullaby Trust, together with the instructions supplied with your cot.
